window: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a real window, and deliberately not modelled on one
note: Exercises the checker's three failure classes so the red path is tested, not just the green one. A green-only test proves a checker runs; it does not prove it discriminates. Paths here are invented (/api/ghost, /api/retired) precisely so this file never reads as a measurement of somebody else's work — this repo is public, and auditing a named window in a fixture would publish an audit nobody asked for.
